topics.title: RAIN RFID Dock-Door Portals & Bulk Tag Ingestion
topics.objective: Process multi-tag simultaneous reads of EPC Gen2 ultra-high frequency (UHF) tags during inbound pallet forklift transits.
topics.exercise: Design an RFID antenna gate configuration eliminating tag read collision when scanning 60 packaged cases per second.

topics.title: Dynamic Velocity Slotting & Pick Path Optimization
topics.objective: Classify SKUs via ABC turnover velocity and allocate high-turnover fast movers to golden ergonomic pick zones.
topics.exercise: Formulate a traveling salesperson (TSP) pick-wave route optimization script minimizing warehouse picker travel distances.

topics.title: Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) & AGV Fleet Coordination
topics.objective: Integrate fleet management software assigning pallet transport missions and automated charging cycles without congestion.
topics.exercise: Build an event-driven dispatch coordinator rerouting AMRs dynamically when congestion is detected in high-density aisles.

topics.title: Automated Cross-Docking & Put-Away Elimination
topics.objective: Match inbound shipment receipts against backorders to bypass storage racks and route cargo straight to outbound staging bays.
topics.exercise: Develop an automated cross-docking decision logic engine reducing average dock-to-departure turnaround times under 90 minutes.

topics.title: Autonomous Drone Cycle Counting & Inventory Reconciliation
topics.objective: Deploy optical and barcode LiDAR scanning drones for automated inventory auditing and root cause analysis of shrinkage.
topics.exercise: Draft an automated inventory reconciliation protocol flagging pallet discrepancies exceeding a 0.1% tolerance threshold.
